contact.name: Peggy Lee
contact.evidence_quote: Peggy Lee ... Well before “creative director” went mainstream, Peggy was living the role. She oversaw every element of her work: writing, producing, staging, costuming, lighting, and shaping the emotional arc of her performances. Few women of her era enjoyed, or insisted upon, such artistic control. She crafted narratives, honed her sound with intention, and built a body of work that made clear she was an artist who authored her own voice. Her influence continues to resonate across generations. Billie Eilish,
